n: Café 2.1 Cu. Ft. Over-the-range Microwave Oven
desc: The Cafe 2.1 Cu. Ft. Over-the-Range Microwave Oven is a stainless steel appliance with an ample cooking space of 2.1 Cu. Ft. Its smooth steel door with a hidden hinge and LED cooktop lighting create an elegant look that complements any kitchen. This appliance offers easy cleaning with the easy clean interior and enables you to keep an eye on your food with the halogen interior oven light.
